SELECT DISTINCT ?member ?name ?sourceId WHERE {

  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), LCASE(STR("Malcolm Byrne"))) ||

limitations: The selected events are illustrative, not a complete account of every recorded activity.

a-0592cc2e151bbe0eaf52.text: Some lifecycle entries do not align neatly when read together. For Protection of Private Residences (Against Targeted Picketing) Bill 2021, they include a Bill Lapsed Event dated 8 November 2024 and Second Stage entries dated 8 November 2024 and 1 May 2025, alongside a Current status. The records provide these entries separately but do not explain their relationship; they do not establish a certified final outcome.
a-0592cc2e151bbe0eaf52.reasoning: The cited lifecycle facts directly record the different statuses and dated activities. Reporting them separately avoids assuming how the entries relate or treating any one entry as a certified final outcome.
conflicts: For both Bills, the retrieved lifecycle entries include a Current status and a Bill Lapsed Event. The records do not explain how these entries relate.
limitations: The lifecycle records do not explain the apparent inconsistencies or certify either Bill’s final outcome.
a-0592cc2e151bbe0eaf52.confidenceRationale: Each status and activity cited is directly recorded. Confidence applies to reporting the entries as supplied, not to interpreting their relationship; no procedural explanation is available.

For example, the records include Second Stage activity for the 2026 Jax’s Law Bill, while the 2024 Protection of Private Residences Bill has both later-stage entries and a recorded lapsed event. limitations: The lifecycle records cover the Bills returned by the sponsorship search and do not certify final outcomes or an exhaustive, up-to-date account.

a-141dd9f5cf78da8dcd6a.text: The recorded history for the Seanad Electoral (University Members) (Amendment) Bill includes Second Stage on 16 July 2020 and Committee Stage entries dated 29 January and 27 March 2025. For the Protection of Private Residences Bill, the records include Committee Stage on 23 May 2024, Report Stage and Fifth Stage on 4 July 2024, a lapsed event dated 8 November 2024, and a further Second Stage entry dated 1 May 2025. These entries are reported as recorded, including where a lapsed event and later stage activity both appear; the records supplied do not explain that apparent inconsistency.

conflicts: For the Protection of Private Residences Bill, the records include a lapsed event dated 8 November 2024 and Second Stage activity dated 1 May 2025.
limitations: These are selected entries, not a complete account of every recorded activity.
a-141dd9f5cf78da8dcd6a.confidenceRationale: The cited dates and activity labels are directly stated in the records. The apparent inconsistency for the Protection of Private Residences Bill is retained rather than reconciled; the selected entries do not establish a final outcome.

The distinction between those entries and a final outcome follows the qualifications in the accepted facts; the available record does not certify completeness or freshness.

a-bc45c07e6a174673806d.confidenceRationale: The cited count, statuses and activity are directly recorded. The explanation is bounded by the records’ stated limits: they do not establish completeness, freshness or final outcomes.

a-141dd9f5cf78da8dcd6a.text: The recorded history for the Seanad Electoral (University Members) (Amendment) Bill includes Second Stage on 16 July 2020 and Committee Stage entries dated 29 January and 27 March 2025. For the Protection of Private Residences Bill, the records include Committee Stage on 23 May 2024, Report Stage and Fifth Stage on 4 July 2024, a lapsed event dated 8 November 2024, and a further Second Stage entry dated 1 May 2025. These entries are reported as recorded, including where a lapsed event and later stage activity both appear; the records supplied do not explain that apparent inconsistency.
a-141dd9f5cf78da8dcd6a.reasoning: The paragraph selects dated entries that illustrate recorded activity across stages and reports all cited events separately. It does not infer a procedural explanation or determine the Bills’ final outcomes.
conflicts: For the Protection of Private Residences Bill, the records include a lapsed event dated 8 November 2024 and Second Stage activity dated 1 May 2025.
limitations: These are selected entries, not a complete account of every recorded activity.
a-141dd9f5cf78da8dcd6a.confidenceRationale: The cited dates and activity labels are directly stated in the records. The apparent inconsistency for the Protection of Private Residences Bill is retained rather than reconciled; the selected entries do not establish a final outcome.

a-6b2a57cb187887b27c80.text: The supplied entries also record Second Stage on 16 September 2026 for the Road Traffic (Amendment) (Jax’s Law) Bill, on 22 September 2026 for the Smokefree Generation Bill, and on 29 September 2026 for the Artificial Intelligence Companion Services (Protection of Children) Bill. These dates provide examples of recent recorded activity in this dataset, not confirmation of subsequent progress or final outcomes.
a-6b2a57cb187887b27c80.reasoning: The examples are direct summaries of the dated Second Stage entries supplied for these Bills. The records do not establish whether later developments occurred.
limitations: The entries are drawn from records of unknown freshness and do not certify the latest development or final outcome.
a-6b2a57cb187887b27c80.confidenceRationale: The cited activity labels and dates are directly recorded and consistent. Their significance is bounded because the supplied records do not establish whether they are current or final.
